evaluation_components.notes: A total of three quizzes (each of 25 marks) will be conducted under continuous evaluation. The best two will be considered for final evaluation (i.e., one buffer).

Three tests (each of 8 marks) will be conducted during the tutorial hours or along with the standard evaluations, and the best two scores will be considered for evaluation. A student's test marks will be counted only if they maintain at least 60% attendance in the tutorial classes. The remaining 2% (4 marks) of the total course marks will be awarded to students who maintain at least 60% attendance in the lecture classes.

attendance_policy: Students are expected to attend all classes to understand the course better.
makeup_policy: (Make-up for quizzes is highly discouraged, as sufficient buffers are provided to the students. Make-up for the mid-semester test and the comprehensive exam may be considered for genuine cases as per the Institute's rules against an application by the student with documents.)
